items.name: CloudWatch Logs
items.text: Log groups hold streams with KMS encryption & retention. CW agent collects EC2/EMR logs; Glue, Lambda & MWAA log to preset paths.

items.name: Filters & Exports
items.text: Metric filters turn log patterns into metrics; subscription filters stream in near real time. Export to S3 or query with Logs Insights.

items.name: Alarms & Events
items.text: Alarms track metrics, math or anomaly bands (OK/ALARM/INSUFFICIENT_DATA) & composite alarms -> SNS. Use EventBridge -> SNS for job events.

items: Log retention defaults to never expire; always set an explicit retention policy to prevent runaway storage costs.
Alarms evaluate metrics; for state-change events (e.g. Glue job FAILED), route through EventBridge to SNS.
Metric filters only match new log events (no backfill); stream logs to S3 via subscription filters to Firehose.
CloudTrail records who called which API; CloudWatch monitors how the system is behaving.
